_derivation.note: official_fields.json is curated from the Shopify Admin REST API Order object reference (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest/latest/resources/order). Fields cover Order root properties, line_items sub-object, customer sub-object, billing/shipping address sub-objects, and refunds sub-object — all relevant to e-commerce reporting. Supermetrics enrichment (shopify-fields.md, 21 metrics / 134 dimensions) surfaces computed aggregates (gross_profit, cost_of_goods_sold, ordered/returned/net quantity, avg_order_value) that require cross-object JOIN logic beyond the single-order JSON payload; these are enrichment_only and not emitted in the official catalog. The connector extracts only at the order grain (orders_daily profile); line_item-grain extraction is not yet implemented.
_derivation.manifest_fields_check: All 5 manifest source_capabilities.fields appear in official_fields.json with matching kind and source_field: order(metric/order), total_price(metric/total_price), total_refunded(metric/total_refunded), created_at(dimension/created_at), transaction_id(dimension/transaction_id).
_derivation.supermetrics_enrichment_only_justificati: Supermetrics computes SALES section metrics (gross_profit, cost_of_goods_sold, ordered_quantity, returned_quantity, net_quantity, units_per_transaction, avg_total_sales) by joining the inventory_items API and applying refund_line_items logic. These cross-object aggregations are not scalars on the Order REST resource and are therefore enrichment_only in this catalog — suspects to verify, never emitted as official fields.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/shopify-fields.md -o server/modules/shopify/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

probe.structural_note: Shopify REST takes a fields= list selecting object properties over a created_at window (limit=1). The probe batches up to 20 fields per request; a field absent from the returned object is recorded empty (Shopify silently omits unknown fields rather than rejecting), so unsupported/empty are distinguished by presence.
